description.value: S'wichcraft Sandwich Co. is a community-rooted sandwich shop in North Vancouver's Queensbury neighbourhood that has been crafting premium handmade sandwiches with house-made sauces and bold flavour combinations since 2011. Founded by a local chef stepping away from corporate restaurants, the shop is built on honest ingredients and neighbourhood connection. Cyclists can order online for pickup or grab a hearty sandwich to go, with a vegan option among the creative menu lineup.

address.value: 644 Queensbury Ave, North Vancouver, BC V7L 3V6
